sourceLabel: Source-blind Sep. 10 late initial scan + White Sox MLB Gate
notes: Four Sep. 10 $1 singles are recorded on the Real Card. Three have direct user placement confirmations in the retained chat extract; McCaffrey is transparently marked partially verified because the chat repeatedly records it as already placed but the earlier confirmation line was not preserved. Numeric grades and confidence remain null because no complete reproducible scoring record was captured.
